note: Alberta Parks campground at Gregoire Lake, 29 km SE of Fort McMurray on Hwy 881; check in at the campground store (groceries, supplies, firewood). Beach, boat launch, fish-cleaning station and a fast-food concession; trails link the loops to the day-use area. --Claude
